entries.title: Ezekiel 35:1
segments: When God's people fall before their enemies, he will raise them up again; but when he destroys the enemies of his people, they perish utterly and for ever.  Where ancient Edom now is, there will be all who hate and persecute Christ's disciples, and think to enrich themselves by their calamities.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:5
segments: Had a perpetual hatred; the hatred of Edom towards Israel and Judah, and his malicious exultation over the calamities which came upon them, is the chief sin laid to the charge of this nation.  Compare

. 
 
  Their iniquity had an end; see note on

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:6
segments: Thou hast not hated blood; hast loved to shed blood

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:10
segments:
These two nations; Judah and Israel. 
 
  The Lord was there; made the land of Judah and Israel, which he had given to Abraham's seed, his peculiar dwelling-place.
